config_1.answer_text: The Supreme Court has jurisdiction under Article 142 of the Constitution to rectify any failure, neglect or inability on part of a public authority. [E1]. A marginalized community student faced an issue with paying IIT admission fees due to a portal login glitch. [E2]. The petitioner was allotted a seat at IIT Dhanbad and sought legal aid from the High Court of Madras, indicating an attempt for redressal through judicial means. [E2].
